name: Steel gear hub on a 50 mm shaft
description: The everyday case. 1000 N-m through a 50 mm fit, 75 mm long, 4140 Q&T shaft in an annealed 1045 hub, -20 to 120 C at 3600 rpm. Expect a feasible window of roughly 43 to 78 um that grades as IT6, with the hub governing the upper limit at the cold, full-speed corner.
